en.headline: CENTRESTAGE fashion fair opens at the Convention Centre from Wednesday
en.dek: The Trade Development Council said about 270 brands from 24 places will show through Saturday, with more than 30 runway presentations including an opening night for Kit Wan Studios.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council's annual fashion fair CENTRESTAGE runs from Wednesday to Saturday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, as part of the third Hong Kong Fashion Fest. The organiser said this year's edition brings together about 270 brands from 24 countries and regions and more than 40 events, including over 30 fashion shows.

The physical fair is open to trade visitors and members of the public aged 18 or above. Hall hours are 10am to 7pm from 2 to 4 September and 10am to 6pm on 5 September, with buyer registration starting half an hour earlier. The venue is at 1 Expo Drive, reached via the Harbour Road entrance. The council said themed zones cover craftsmanship, contemporary, urban, athleisure, circular fashion and accessories.

The opening presentation, CENTRESTAGE ELITES, is scheduled on Wednesday evening and features a solo runway by Hong Kong-born studio Kit Wan Studios. The Fashion Hong Kong Runway Show follows on Thursday under the theme "Hong Kong Dopamine", with local labels 112 mountainyam, Angus Tsui, ARTY:ACTIVE and Z I D I. A Hype² pavilion of streetwear brands is listed for Friday.

The Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency is the government sponsor. An online sourcing platform on the council's site runs separately from 2 August to 1 October. Visitors should check the organiser's registration arrangements before travelling.

zh.headline: 香港國際時尚匯展周三起於會展舉行
zh.dek: 貿發局表示約270個品牌來自24個國家及地區，展期至周六，並有逾30場時裝表演，開幕夜聚焦Kit Wan Studios。
body: 由香港貿易發展局主辦的年度時裝展CENTRESTAGE，周三至周六於灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行，屬第三屆「香港時裝蒜」旗艦節目之一。主辦單位指今屆約有270個品牌來自24個國家及地區，同期安排超過40場活動，包括逾30場時裝表演。
實體展開放予18歲或以上的業內人士及公眾參觀。9月2至4日開放時間為上午10時至下午7時，9月5日上午10時至下午6時，買家登記提早半小時開始。場地為博覽道一號會展，經港灣道入口。展區分為工藝、當代、都市、運動休閒、循環時尚及配飾。
開幕表演CENTRESTAGE ELITES定於周三晚舉行，由香港出生的跨界工作室Kit Wan Studios作個人時裝騷。周四「Fashion Hong Kong」時裝表演以「香港多巴胺」為題，參展本地品牌包括112 mountainyam、ANGUS TSUI、ARTY:ACTIVE及Z I D I。周五設Hype²潮流品牌展區。
特區政府文創產業發展處為資助機構。貿發網採購平台已由8月2日運作至10月1日。參觀人士出發前應按主辦單位安排完成登記。
